title: Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Kept-Vehicle Settlement Worksheet
content:
**Worksheet clause.** On a Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage kept-vehicle settlement the kept value is the actual cash value on the claim's total-loss declaration less the unrepaired prior damage noted on it, rounded to the cent. The kept-vehicle sales tax is the kept value less the salvage deduction, times the policy state's sales tax percentage, rounded to the cent, and the title fee is the policy state's title fee. The retained-equipment payment is the documented custom equipment on the declaration up to the option's custom equipment limit. The salvage deduction is the highest salvage bid on the declaration. The kept net deductible is the deductible stated on the claim's latest accepted coverage decision less the vehicle's Deductible Rewards credit balance applied up to that deductible. The kept-vehicle settlement is the kept value plus the kept-vehicle sales tax plus the title fee plus the retained-equipment payment, less the kept net deductible and less the salvage deduction, each figure rounded to the cent before it is added.

## State figures used on the worksheet

| Policy state of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy | Sales tax percentage | Title fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| OH | 5.75 | 15.00 |
| IN | 7.00 | 15.00 |
| KY | 6.00 | 9.00 |
| VA | 4.15 | 15.00 |
| WV | 6.00 | 15.00 |

## Worksheet lines

| Line | Figure |
|---|---|
| 1 | Kept value: actual cash value less noted prior damage, rounded to the cent |
| 2 | Salvage deduction: the highest salvage bid on the declaration |
| 3 | Kept-vehicle sales tax: line 1 less line 2, times the state percentage, rounded to the cent |
| 4 | Title fee of the state |
| 5 | Retained-equipment payment: documented custom equipment up to the option's limit |
| 6 | Kept net deductible: latest accepted coverage decision deductible less the credit balance applied up to it |
| 7 | Kept-vehicle settlement: lines 1, 3, 4 and 5 added together, less line 6 and less line 2 |

## Worked worksheet (hypothetical figures)

KY policy; actual cash value 12000.00; prior damage noted 300.00; highest salvage bid 2500.00; documented custom equipment 600.00 under an option whose limit is 1500; latest accepted coverage decision deductible 1000.00; Deductible Rewards balance 250.00.

- Line 1: 11700.00. Line 2: 2500.00.
- Line 3: 11700.00 less 2500.00 gives 9200.00; times 6.00 percent gives 552.00.
- Line 4: 9.00. Line 5: 600.00.
- Line 6: 1000.00 less 250.00 gives 750.00.
- Line 7: 11700.00 plus 552.00 plus 9.00 plus 600.00 gives 12861.00; less 750.00 and less 2500.00 gives 9611.00.
